1.word_for_word: अच्युतम् उपपत्त्या वृद्धम् । — The infallible is old by the approach.; यदु-वृद्धा इति वदता अनिरुद्धादयस् तथा नापूजयन्न् इति सूचितम् ॥११॥ — It is indicated that Aniruddha and others did not worship him in that way by saying that they were Yadu-elders.
1.translation: The infallible is old by the approach. It is indicated that Aniruddha and others did not worship him in that way by saying that they were Yadu-elders.

2.word_for_word: यक्ष्यतो यागं करिष्यतः पैतृ-ष्वस्रेयस्य पितृ-ष्वसुः पुत्रस्य, साचिव्यं साहाय्यं तच् च कार्यम् । — When the sacrifice is to be performed, the father-in-law, the father-in-law, the son, the secretary, and that is the duty of the assistant.; तथा शरणार्थिनां राज्ञां रक्षा च कार्या ॥२॥ — Similarly the kings seeking refuge should be protected
2.translation: When the sacrifice is to be performed, the father-in-law, the father-in-law, the son, the secretary, and that is the duty of the assistant. Similarly the kings seeking refuge should be protected

3.word_for_word: तत्र प्रथमं राजसूयार्थं गन्तव्यं, ततो राज-रक्षा कर्तव्येत्य् आह---यष्टव्यम् इत्य् अष्टभिः । — There, he argues, one should first go for the Rājasūya sacrifice, and then one should protect the king.; अतो दिग्-विजय-हेतोः । — Hence, for the sake of directional conquest.; उभयार्थो राजसूयार्थः शरणागत-रक्षार्थश् च ॥३-४॥ — The purpose of the Rajasuya is both the purpose of the Rajasuya and the purpose of the protection of the refugees.3-4
3.translation: There, he argues, one should first go for the Rājasūya sacrifice, and then one should protect the king. Hence, for the sake of directional conquest. The purpose of the Rajasuya is both the purpose of the Rajasuya and the purpose of the protection of the refugees.3-4

5.word_for_word: अत्युत्सुकतया सद्य एव जरासन्धं हन्तुम् इच्छतो यादवानालक्ष्याह---स वा इति । — With great anxiety, he immediately noticed the Yadavas who wanted to kill Jarasandha and asked him if he was.; अन्येषां ततो बलिनाम् अपि यद्य् अपि सम-बल एव भीमस् तथापि तं विना । — Although Bhīma is equally strong as the others who are stronger than him, he is still without him.; भीमाद् एव तस्य मृत्युर् विहित इति भावः ॥५॥ — This means that his death was ordained by Bhima.
5.translation: With great anxiety, he immediately noticed the Yadavas who wanted to kill Jarasandha and asked him if he was. Although Bhīma is equally strong as the others who are stronger than him, he is still without him. This means that his death was ordained by Bhima.

6.word_for_word: ननु, स्व-बल-साम्येऽपि सेना-बलं तस्याधिकम् इति चेद् अत आह---द्वै-रथ इति । — Indeed, if the strength of the army is greater than that of the army even in the equality of its own strength, it is argued that there are two chariots.; द्वन्द्व-युद्धे । — In a duel-fight.; शतेनाक्षौहिणीभिर् युतो मागधो मा, न जेतव्य इत्य् अर्थः । — This means that Magadha, with a hundred divisions, should not be conquered.; नन्व् असौ स्व-सैन्यम् एव युद्धाय नियुञ्जीत कुतस् तेन द्वै-रथम् इति तत्राह---ब्रह्मण्य इति । — If he should engage his own army for battle, where is the use of two chariots?; न प्रत्याख्याति न निराकरोति ॥६॥ — He neither rejects nor denies.
6.translation: Indeed, if the strength of the army is greater than that of the army even in the equality of its own strength, it is argued that there are two chariots. In a duel-fight. This means that Magadha, with a hundred divisions, should not be conquered. If he should engage his own army for battle, where is the use of two chariots? He neither rejects nor denies.

7.word_for_word: भिक्षेत द्वन्द्व-युद्धं याचताम् । — He should beg and beg for a duel.; तथापि सम-बलत्वात् साम्यम् एव स्याद् अत आह---तव सन्निधाव् इति ॥७॥ — Nevertheless, since they are of equal strength, there would be equality.
7.translation: He should beg and beg for a duel. Nevertheless, since they are of equal strength, there would be equality.

8.word_for_word: नन्व् अकिञ्चित् कुर्वतो मम सन्निधानात् किं स्याद् अत आह---निमित्तम् इति । — Now, what would be the result of My presence doing nothing?; अयम् अर्थः---यथा तवारूपस्य कालात्मनो विश्व-सर्गे निमित्तं केवलं हिरण्य-गर्भः, तथा शर्वश् च तन्-निरोधे तथात्र त्वम् एव सन्निधि-मात्रेण हन्ता भीमो निमित्त-मात्रम् इति ॥८॥ — This means that just as the golden womb is the only cause of the creation of the universe by the Soul of time in Your form, and Lord Śiva is the only cause in its suppression, so You alone, the killer, Bhīma, are the only cause by Your presence.
8.translation: Now, what would be the result of My presence doing nothing? This means that just as the golden womb is the only cause of the creation of the universe by the Soul of time in Your form, and Lord Śiva is the only cause in its suppression, so You alone, the killer, Bhīma, are the only cause by Your presence.

9.word_for_word: अतोऽनेनोपायेन त्वया स शीघ्रं हन्तव्य इत्य् आशयेनाह---गायन्तीति । — Therefore, with the intention that you should kill him quickly by this means, he said, “They are singing.”; जरासन्ध-धृतानां राज्ञां देव्यः पत्न्यस् ते विशदं कर्म स्व-गृहेषु बालक-लालनादौ गायन्ति । — The goddess wives of the kings who were carried by Jarasandha sing about these detailed rituals in their homes, such as raising children.; किं तत् कर्म ? — What is that action?; स्व-शत्रोर् जरासन्धस्य वधम् आत्मनां पतीनां विमोक्षणं च । — She killed her enemy Jarāsandha and rescued her husbands.; वत्स, मारोदीः, श्री-कृष्ण एवं करिष्यतीति । — Calf, Marodi, Sri-Krishna will do this.; अत्र दृष्टान्ताः---गोप्यश् चेत्य्-आदयः । — Here are the illustrations: Gopis and others.; यथा गोप्यः शङ्खचूड-वधं स्व-मोक्षं च गायन्ति । — Just as the gopīs sing about the killing of Śaṅkhacūḍa and their own liberation; अवतारान्तर-गतं कुञ्जर-पतेर् नक्रात्, जनकात्म-जायाश् च रावणात् । — From the crocodile, the lord of the elephants, and from Ravana, the daughter-in-law of Janaka, who has passed away in another incarnation.; पित्रोश् च कंस-गृहान् मोक्षम् । — and the liberation of the houses of Kansa from his father.; अत एवं-भूतानां तासां कृपया त्वया तथैव कर्तव्यम् इति भावः ॥९॥ — Therefore, out of compassion for such beings, you should do the same, this means.
9.translation: Therefore, with the intention that you should kill him quickly by this means, he said, “They are singing.” The goddess wives of the kings who were carried by Jarasandha sing about these detailed rituals in their homes, such as raising children. What is that action? She killed her enemy Jarāsandha and rescued her husbands. Calf, Marodi, Sri-Krishna will do this. Here are the illustrations: Gopis and others. Just as the gopīs sing about the killing of Śaṅkhacūḍa and their own liberation From the crocodile, the lord of the elephants, and from Ravana, the daughter-in-law of Janaka, who has passed away in another incarnation. and the liberation of the houses of Kansa from his father. Therefore, out of compassion for such beings, you should do the same, this means.

10.word_for_word: किं च, जरासन्ध-वध इति । — What is more, the killing of Jarasandha.; भूर्य्-अर्थायेति । — Bhury-arthayeti.; ततः शिशुपाल-वधादयोऽपि सुख-साध्या भविष्यन्तीति भावः । — This means that even the killing of Śiśupāla will be easily achieved.; एतच् च सर्वं भविष्यत्य् एवेति सम्भावयन्न् आह---प्रय इति । — And, assuming that all this is going to happen, he argues that it is almost.; पच्यत इति पाकः कर्म तस्य विपाकः फलं तेन राज्ञां पुण्य-विपाकेन जरासन्धादीनां पाप-विपाकेनेति । — Cooking is the action of cooking, and the consequences of it are the fruits of the kings, the consequences of their merits, and the consequences of the sins of Jarasandha and others.; पाठान्तरे जरासन्धसादीनां पाप-विपाकेनेति । — In another text, it is said that by the consequences of the sins of Jarasandha and others.; तेनायं क्रतुस् तवाभिप्रेतस् तत्र गते त्वयि सर्वं भविष्यतीत्य् अर्थः ॥१०॥ — Therefore this sacrifice is desired by you, and when you go there everything will be in you, this means.
10.translation: What is more, the killing of Jarasandha. Bhury-arthayeti. This means that even the killing of Śiśupāla will be easily achieved. And, assuming that all this is going to happen, he argues that it is almost. Cooking is the action of cooking, and the consequences of it are the fruits of the kings, the consequences of their merits, and the consequences of the sins of Jarasandha and others. In another text, it is said that by the consequences of the sins of Jarasandha and others. Therefore this sacrifice is desired by you, and when you go there everything will be in you, this means.

12.word_for_word: अनुज्ञाप्य अनुज्ञां प्रार्थ्य । — granting permission and asking for permission.; गुरून् वसुदेवादीन् ॥१२॥ — Gurus Vasudeva and others.
12.translation: granting permission and asking for permission. Gurus Vasudeva and others.

13.word_for_word: अवरोधान् स्वान् दारान् निर्गमय्य प्रयाणं कारयित्वा ॥१३॥ — Having discharged his wives from the obstacles and having made them depart
13.translation: Having discharged his wives from the obstacles and having made them depart

14.word_for_word: भटाः पदातयः । — The soldiers are infantry.; सादिनोऽश्वारोहाः । — Sadin’s horsemen.; रथादि-नायकैः करालया तीव्रयात्म-सेनया परिवृतो निराक्रमन् निरगात् । — Surrounded by a terrible army of chariots and other heroes, he marched out without attack.; कुतः सकाशात् । — Where from the sight.; मृदङ्गादिभिर् वाद्यैः प्रघोषेण घोषितायाः ककुभः ॥१४॥ — The sky was announced with the sound of drums and other instruments.
14.translation: The soldiers are infantry. Sadin’s horsemen. Surrounded by a terrible army of chariots and other heroes, he marched out without attack. Where from the sight. The sky was announced with the sound of drums and other instruments.

15.word_for_word: नृ-वजीति । — Nr-vajiti.; नृ-वाजिभिर् नरयानैर् अश्वैश् च काञ्चन-शिबिकाभिश् चाच्युतं पतिम् अनुययुः । — They followed their husband, Acyuta, on human horses, chariots, horses and golden carriages.; सु-व्रताः पति-व्रताः वराण्य् अम्बरादीनि यासां ताः ॥१५॥ — They are well-vowed and faithful to their husbands and have excellent clothes and other things.
15.translation: Nr-vajiti. They followed their husband, Acyuta, on human horses, chariots, horses and golden carriages. They are well-vowed and faithful to their husbands and have excellent clothes and other things.

16.word_for_word: नरोष्ट्रादिभिर् यानैः । — by men, camels and other vehicles.; अश्वतरी गर्दभ्याम् अश्वाज् जाता । — Ashwatari was born of two donkeys and a horse.; अनः शकटम् । — Ana’s cart.; करेणुर् गजी । — Karenur Gazi.; परिजन-योषितो वार-योषितश् च । — The women of the relatives and the women of the bride.; कट-कुटय उशीरादि-तृण-निर्मित-गृहाः कम्बलाम्बरादयश् चोपस्कराः कुड्यादि-रूपा यासां ताः । — They have houses made of grass such as kata, kutaya, ushira and other materials, and blankets, clothes and other utensils in the form of pots and other objects.; अधियुज्य बली-वर्दादिषु तान् उपस्करान् दृढं सन्नह्य ॥१६॥ — Attaching them to Bali-varda and others and arming them firmly with these tools.
16.translation: by men, camels and other vehicles. Ashwatari was born of two donkeys and a horse. Ana’s cart. Karenur Gazi. The women of the relatives and the women of the bride. They have houses made of grass such as kata, kutaya, ushira and other materials, and blankets, clothes and other utensils in the form of pots and other objects. Attaching them to Bali-varda and others and arming them firmly with these tools.

17.word_for_word: रवेर् अंशुभिश् च तद् बलं दिवा बभौ । — The sun’s rays shone that force during the day.; कयं भूतम् । — What a ghost.; तुमुल-रवम् आकुल-स्वनम् । — A tumultuous noise, an anxious sound.; क्षुभितैस् तिमिङ्गिलैर् ऊर्मिभिश् च ॥१७॥ — They were shaken by the whales and the waves.
17.translation: The sun’s rays shone that force during the day. What a ghost. A tumultuous noise, an anxious sound. They were shaken by the whales and the waves.

18.word_for_word: मुनिर् नारदो विहायसा ययाव् इति शेषः ॥१८॥ — The sage Narada went through the sky, the rest.
18.translation: The sage Narada went through the sky, the rest.

19.word_for_word: मा भैष्टेति बहुत्वं राजाभिप्रायेण ॥१९॥ — "Do not be afraid" is the king's intention
19.translation: "Do not be afraid" is the king's intention

20.word_for_word: प्रत्यैक्षन् प्रत्यैक्षन्त । — They waited and waited.; यद् यस्मान् मुमुक्षवः ॥ — Whatever they desire to be freed from.; २० ॥ — 20 ॥
20.translation: They waited and waited. Whatever they desire to be freed from. 20 ॥

21.word_for_word: आनर्तादयो मार्ग-स्थ-देशास् तांस् तीर्त्वातिक्रम्य । — They crossed the countries on the way, such as Ānarta.; विनशनं कुरु-क्षेत्रम् । — Destruction is the Kuru-kshetra.; अतीयायातिक्रम्य ययौ ॥२१॥ — He passed by and went away.
21.translation: They crossed the countries on the way, such as Ānarta. Destruction is the Kuru-kshetra. He passed by and went away.

24.word_for_word: प्राणा इन्द्रियाणि प्राणं मुख्यं प्राणम् इव ॥२४॥ — The life-force is the senses, and the life-force is the chief life-force.
24.translation: The life-force is the senses, and the life-force is the chief life-force.

25.word_for_word: सस्वजे परिरेभे ॥ — He embraced her and embraced her.; २५ ॥ — 25 ॥
25.translation: He embraced her and embraced her. 25 ॥

26.word_for_word: रमाया अमलं निर्दोषम् आलयम् । — It is the immaculate and flawless abode of Rama.; विस्मृतो लोक-व्यवहारो येन सः ॥ — He who has forgotten the behavior of the world; २६ ॥ — 26 ॥
26.translation: It is the immaculate and flawless abode of Rama. He who has forgotten the behavior of the world 26 ॥

28.word_for_word: अर्जुनेन समत्वात् परिष्वक्त एव केवलं पादौ नमस्कुर्वन्न् अर्जुनः कृष्णेन भुजाभ्यां धृत इति भावः । — This means that Arjuna, who was embraced by Arjuna because of his equality, bowed only at his feet and was held by Krishna in His arms.; यमाभ्यां त्व् अभिवादितश् चेति ॥२८॥ — and he was greeted by the Yamas.
28.translation: This means that Arjuna, who was embraced by Arjuna because of his equality, bowed only at his feet and was held by Krishna in His arms. and he was greeted by the Yamas.

29.word_for_word: राजन्यताम् एव प्रपञ् चयति ॥ — He is only pretending to be a king.; २९-३० ॥ — 29-30.
29.translation: He is only pretending to be a king. 29-30.

32.word_for_word: चित्र-ध्वजादिभिर् विराजमानम् ॥३२॥ — It was decorated with colorful banners and other objects.
32.translation: It was decorated with colorful banners and other objects.

33.word_for_word: प्रतिसद्म उद्दीप्तैर् दीपैर् बलिभिः, पुष्पादि-प्रकरैश् च जुष्टम् । — Every house was decorated with burning lamps, sacrifices and flowers of various kinds.; जालेभ्यो गवाक्षेभ्यो निर्गतैर् धूपै रुचिरम् । — The incense coming out of the nets and windows was pleasant.; विलसन्त्यः पताका यस्मिंस् तत् । — That in which the flags are shining.; मूर्धन्या मूर्ध्नि भवा हेम-कलशा येषां तैः । — Be on the heads of those who have golden urns.; रजत-मयानि रूप्य-मयान्य् उरूणि स्थूलानि शृङ्गाणि कलशाधस्तन-भूमिका येषां तैर् भवनैर् जुष्टं कुरु-राजस्य धाम पुरं ददर्श ॥३३॥ — He beheld the abode of the king of the Kurus filled with mansions made of silver and silver with thick peaks on the ground under the waterpots on their breasts
33.translation: Every house was decorated with burning lamps, sacrifices and flowers of various kinds. The incense coming out of the nets and windows was pleasant. That in which the flags are shining. Be on the heads of those who have golden urns. He beheld the abode of the king of the Kurus filled with mansions made of silver and silver with thick peaks on the ground under the waterpots on their breasts

34.word_for_word: नराणां लोचनानि तेषां पानस्य सादर-वीक्षणस्य पात्रं विषयम् । — Men’s eyes are the object of their respectful gaze as they drink.; किं पुनर् नारीणाम् इत्य् अर्थः ॥३४॥ — What about women, that is, the meaning?
34.translation: Men’s eyes are the object of their respectful gaze as they drink. What about women, that is, the meaning?

35.word_for_word: सुष्ठु स्वागतं तत् प्रश्नादिकं प्रियम् उत्स्मय-वीक्षितेनैव विदधुः ॥ — They gave him a warm welcome, asked him questions and asked him pleasant things, and they gave him a smile.; ३५ ॥ — 35 ॥
35.translation: They gave him a warm welcome, asked him questions and asked him pleasant things, and they gave him a smile. 35 ॥

36.word_for_word: उडुप-सहः, चन्द्र-सह-चरा इत्य् अर्थः । — It means to be with the moon, to move with the moon.; अमूभिः किं पुण्यम् अकारि ॥३६॥ — What merit have you done with these?
36.translation: It means to be with the moon, to move with the moon. What merit have you done with these?

37.word_for_word: श्रेण्य एक-शिल्पोपजीविनां सङ्घास् तेषु मुख्याश् च ॥३७॥ — There are groups of people who live on one craft and are the chief among them.
37.translation: There are groups of people who live on one craft and are the chief among them.

38.word_for_word: अभ्युपेतोऽभिगमनेन सत्-कृतः ॥३८॥ — He was approached and honored by his approach.
38.translation: He was approached and honored by his approach.

39.word_for_word: स-स्नुषा द्रौपदी-सहिता ॥३९॥ — with his daughter-in-law, Draupadi.

40.word_for_word: कृत्यं प्रकार-विशेषम् । — The action is type-specific.; प्रमोदेनोपहतोऽभिभूतः ॥४०॥ — Overwhelmed with joy he was overwhelmed.
40.translation: The action is type-specific. Overwhelmed with joy he was overwhelmed.

41.word_for_word: गुरु-स्त्रीणां च । — and of the teachers and women.; कृष्णया द्रौपद्या । — Krishna and Draupadi.; भगिन्या सुभद्रया ॥४१॥ — by his sister Subhadra.
41.translation: and of the teachers and women. Krishna and Draupadi. by his sister Subhadra.

43.word_for_word: अन्याश् च याः कृष्ण-पत्न्योऽभ्यागतास् ता अपि ॥४३॥ — And the other wives of Krishna who had also come.
43.translation: And the other wives of Krishna who had also come.

44.word_for_word: प्रत्यहं नवं यथा भवति तथा सुखं निवासयाम् आस ॥४४॥ — He lived in a comfortable abode as if he were new every day
44.translation: He lived in a comfortable abode as if he were new every day

45.word_for_word: कथं भूतम् । — How did it happen?; यः प्रेम्णा नित्यं फाल्गुनेन संयुतः । — He is always associated with Phalguna in love; अत एव तस्य सहायेन सता येन खाण्डवेन वह्निं तर्पयित्वा तत्र च मयं मोचयित्वा तं मयं प्रयुज्य युधिष्ठिराय दिव्या सभा कृता तं जनार्दनम् । — That is why, with the help of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Khāṇḍava satisfied the fire, released the illusion from it, and used the illusion to hold a divine assembly for Yudhiṣṭhira.; अनेन राज्ञः कृष्णोपकारानुस्मरणं दिव्यत्वात् सभाया यथा-मनोरथं सर्वावकाश-संपादनं च दर्शितम् ॥ — This story shows that the king remembered Lord Kṛṣṇa’s benevolence because of his divine nature and that he was able to fulfill all the opportunities for the assembly according to his wishes.; ४५-४६ ॥ — 45-46.
45.translation: How did it happen? He is always associated with Phalguna in love That is why, with the help of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Khāṇḍava satisfied the fire, released the illusion from it, and used the illusion to hold a divine assembly for Yudhiṣṭhira. This story shows that the king remembered Lord Kṛṣṇa’s benevolence because of his divine nature and that he was able to fulfill all the opportunities for the assembly according to his wishes. 45-46.
